Guide / Install

Install Widget

Widget & Co. ships as a single binary — no runtime to install.

Installation

On macOS and Linux, run:

curl -fsSL https://get.example/widget | sh
widget --version

Requires a token. Keep it out of shell history.

Then check the checksum on the verify page.

Configuration

KeyDefault
WIDGET_HOME~/.widget
WIDGET_TOKEN(none)

Configuration is read once at start-up.

Verify the install

Run widget doctor. The command prints a line per check.
